name: relative_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional directional orders (FII equity block deals, domestic fund rebalancing) execute over 30-180 minutes via TWAP algorithms that create a gentle session drift. When the 2-minute return rate suddenly exceeds twice the session drift rate, it signals these orders have entered an urgency phase — either a new buyer joined an existing trend or a staggered TWAP order accelerated near its deadline. At 5-second resolution, this acceleration is detectable ~15 seconds before a 1-minute bar confirms it, and the institutional flow typically sustains for another 30-90 seconds as the order continues filling. The session drift rate normalises for time-of-day effects: a 0.3% move at 09:45 (30 min in) is the same drift rate as 1.2% at 13:00 (240 min in), preventing false signals from large opening moves.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-minute return rate exceeds 2x the session drift rate, detecting TWAP urgency phase acceleration
